request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Create one realistic photograph for an English-learning app that clearly communicates: "The boy wants three eggs."
Scene: an ordinary home kitchen at breakfast. A boy about ten years old sits at a wooden table, looking expectantly toward an adult woman who stands beside the table. The woman is holding a plain white plate just out of his reach. On that plate are exactly THREE whole, unpeeled boiled eggs, clearly separated and easy to count. The boy points toward the eggs with one hand and holds his other hand open toward the plate, asking for them; he is not yet eating or holding any egg. The woman looks at him attentively. Show both faces, both of the boy's hands, the woman's plate-holding hands, and the complete plate with all three eggs unobstructed. Make the requesting interaction natural and immediately understandable.
Style: believable candid editorial photography, natural skin texture, realistic hands and anatomy, ordinary cotton clothing, gentle morning window light, warm but neutral colors, subtle kitchen background. No beauty retouching, plastic skin, dramatic color grading, or exaggerated expressions.
Composition: one coherent landscape 3:2 photograph, medium two-person shot at table height, slightly elevated enough to see and count the eggs. Keep faces, gesture and plate large and inside the central area, readable on a phone. Natural proportions, softly blurred background but sharp faces, hands and eggs.
Constraints: exactly one boy, one adult woman and three eggs total. No other food, no extra eggs or people, no text, no numbers, no captions, no symbols, no arrows, no speech bubbles, no borders, no collage, no illustration, no watermark.

cost.basis: Reported usage at uncached list rates; before tax or discounts, not an invoice.

agent_review.observed_description: A seated boy points at a white plate and opens his other hand toward it, looking expectantly at a woman holding it. Exactly three separate brown eggs are clearly visible. Both faces, hands and the complete plate are visible in one natural kitchen photograph.
agent_review.framing: Full 3:2 Use prompt. Not approved for an unreviewed 4:5 choice crop.
